name: usha_bgm_warm
caption: Uplifting warm devotional sunrise instrumental, no vocals. Major key, hopeful, joyful and gentle, a glowing morning feeling of gratitude and celebration. Harmonium and santoor playing a bright simple melody, light dholak and tabla groove, soft manjira, warm string pad, tanpura drone, soft temple bells, gradually building to a happy glowing peak at the middle and ending peacefully. Festive Indian devotional, cinematic, positive, uplifting, smooth, no sad or minor melancholy mood, no harsh high-pitched sounds, no electronic sounds.

name: usha_bgm_bright
caption: Cheerful bright festive Indian morning instrumental, no vocals. Joyful major-key melody on bamboo flute played softly and sweetly in the low register, plus sitar plucks, rhythmic tabla and dholak, shaker and manjira, warm bass, tanpura, light bells, devotional and celebratory like a Chhath puja sunrise at the ghat, hopeful, energetic but gentle, smooth, upbeat, not sad, not slow, not dramatic, no shrill sounds, no electronic drops.
